title: Symbolic Informalization: Fluent, Productive, Multilingual
abstract: arXiv:2606.16893v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Symbolic informalization enables a reliable conversion of formal mathematics to natural language. It has the potential to make machine-checked content human-readable without loss of precision. In a traditional proof system usage, symbolic informalization generalizes the limited mechanisms of syntactic sugar into the ordinary language of mathematics. In a setting where proofs are constructed by artificial intelligence and autoformalization, symbolic informalization can explain what precisely has been constructed. This paper outlines the project Informath, which aims to show how symbolic informalization can produce fluent text with a reasonable development effort and address multiple formal and natural languages. Informath is based on an interlingual architecture, where Dedukti works as a hub between different proof systems (Agda, Lean, Rocq) and Grammatical Framework (GF) takes care of linguistic correctness and variation in different

translated_title: 符号非形式化：流畅、高效、多语言
translated_abstract: 符号非形式化能够将形式化数学可靠地转换为自然语言，它有潜力使机器验证的内容变得人类可读且不损失精确性。在传统证明系统的使用中，符号非形式化将语法糖的有限机制泛化为数学的日常语言。在由人工智能构建证明和自动形式化的场景中，符号非形式化能够精确解释所构建的内容。本文概述了Informath项目，该项目旨在展示符号非形式化如何以合理的开发成本生成流畅的文本，并同时支持多种形式语言和自然语言。Informath基于一种中间语言架构，其中Dedukti作为不同证明系统（Agda、Lean、Rocq）之间的枢纽，而语法框架负责不同……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Informath项目展示了基于Dedukti作为证明系统枢纽和语法框架处理语言的中间语言架构，符号非形式化能够以合理的开发成本将机器验证的数学转换为流畅、多语言且不损失精确性的自然语言文本。
en_tdlr: The Informath project demonstrates that symbolic informalization, built on an interlingual architecture with Dedukti as a hub between proof systems (Agda, Lean, Rocq) and Grammatical Framework for linguistic correctness, can reliably convert machine-checked mathematics into fluent, multilingual natural language text without loss of precision.
